coverage: Czech state-controlled companies from the 2024 public-entity inventory, plus three selected enterprises per other comparison country. Missing revenue and ownership shares remain null; this is not a complete state portfolio.

fx.basis: 2024 annual average; local-currency units per EUR

sources.label: National Bank of Ukraine monthly exchange rates

fx.note: UAH/EUR is the arithmetic mean of the National Bank of Ukraine's twelve 2024 monthly period-average rates. All other non-EUR rates are 2024 annual averages from the ECB/OeNB table.
